name: Team Topologies Lifecycle
description: Orchestration practice coordinating team structure design with organizational evolution through Team Topologies patterns and terminology unification.

narratives.name: Orchestration Practice Intent
narratives.description: Explanation of Team Topologies Lifecycle orchestration role coordinating team design with organizational evolution.

narrativeContexts.context: Team Topologies Lifecycle orchestrates two complementary value streams: Team Structure & Cognitive Load practice focuses on team design, boundaries, and interaction modes; Organizational Evolution & Sensing practice governs topology adaptation through continuous organizational sensing and incremental evolution.

This orchestration practice unifies Team Topologies terminology across both practices through canonical aliases (TVP, Team API, Interaction Mode, Topology) and coordinates progression through two primary lifecycle patterns: Team Topology Evolution Journey aligns team formation with organizational change sensing across five views, while Platform as Product Adoption coordinates platform maturation with team readiness through self-service capability development.

The orchestration enables organizations to progress both team structure design and continuous topology evolution in coordinated fashion, ensuring that team boundaries evolve in response to sensing signals and platform capabilities mature alongside team interaction patterns.

patterns.name: Team Topology Evolution Journey
patterns.description: Coordinates team formation and organizational change progression across five evolutionary views, aligning team structure design with continuous sensing and adaptation.

patternViews.name: Topology Foundation
patternViews.description: Establish initial team structure with cognitive load assessment and organizational change recognition.

narrativeContexts.context: Teams are seeded with appropriate size (5-9 people) and cognitive load boundaries, while organizational need for topology evolution is recognized through bottleneck identification.

patternViews.name: Interaction Design
patternViews.description: Define team interaction modes and develop organizational change strategy for topology adaptation.

narrativeContexts.context: Teams establish explicit interaction modes (Collaboration, X-as-a-Service, Facilitating) while change plans map communication pathways for continuous topology adaptation.

patternViews.name: Platform-Team Integration
patternViews.description: Align platform readiness with team performance and enable organizational change execution.

narrativeContexts.context: Platform achieves autonomous developer self-service while teams consistently deliver value, enabled by playbooks addressing behavioral pushback to topology changes.

patternViews.name: Self-Service Maturation
patternViews.description: Optimize platform consumption interface while sustaining team performance and embedding organizational change.

narrativeContexts.context: Platform interface dynamically adapts to minimize cognitive load through deep telemetry while comprehensive change management toolkits ensure sustained topology evolution capability.

patternViews.name: Continuous Evolution
patternViews.description: Sustain platform evolution with ongoing topology adaptation and embedded organizational change capability.

narrativeContexts.context: Platform autonomously adapts through predictive scaling and continuous feedback while teams serve as sensors detecting topology adjustment needs, with change management embedded as organizational capability.

patterns.name: Platform as Product Adoption
patterns.description: Coordinates platform maturation with team readiness through progressive self-service capability development aligned with interaction mode evolution.

patternViews.name: Platform Vision & Team Formation
patternViews.description: Envision platform consumption interface while forming teams with clear ownership boundaries.

narrativeContexts.context: Platform interface capabilities are defined to reduce cognitive load while teams establish stable membership and ownership boundaries, setting foundation for product-centric platform approach.

patternViews.name: Self-Service Availability & Team Collaboration
patternViews.description: Make platform interface accessible while teams establish explicit interaction modes for consumption.

narrativeContexts.context: Platform interface becomes accessible to consumers while teams define interaction modes (X-as-a-Service for platform consumption, Facilitating for adoption support), enabling voluntary platform adoption.

patternViews.name: Autonomous Self-Service & Team Performance
patternViews.description: Enable independent platform consumption while teams consistently deliver value through reduced cognitive load.

narrativeContexts.context: Consumers independently use platform interface without handoffs while teams perform at high level, demonstrating platform-as-product success through measurable cognitive load reduction and value delivery.
